lines.text: David calls the LORD his light and salvation, and his heart will not fear though an army encamps.
David asks to dwell in the LORD's house, and says He will set him high upon a tower.
David asks the LORD to hear him, and says the LORD will receive him though his parents forsake him.
Because of oppressors David asks for a level path, and not to be handed over since the Philistines rise up.
David is certain he will see the LORD's goodness, and he says to wait patiently for the LORD.
